tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Shows which Xyla shop this connection acts for and whether it can only read or can also make changes.

tools.name: shop_overview
tools.description: Summarises this Xyla shop: its plan, AI credits left, whether autopilot is on, how many posts wait for approval, the next 3 posts due, and any social account that needs fixing.

tools.name: upcoming_posts
tools.description: Lists the posts this Xyla shop will publish, day by day, for up to 7 days from a start date (the shop's today if left out). Each post has its platforms, send time in the shop's time zone, type, caption and media links. Posts waiting for approval are not here: use pending_approvals.

tools.name: pending_approvals
tools.description: Lists the posts in this Xyla shop that wait for the merchant's approval before they are scheduled, 12 per page, with captions and media links. When the shop is still on its first batch, returns that batch as one draft: it is approved as a whole, not post by post.

tools.name: insights
tools.description: Shows how this Xyla shop's published posts performed over the last 7, 14, 30 or 90 days: reach, views, engagement, followers per account, and the top posts. Same data as the Insights page in Xyla.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Shows each social account connected to this Xyla shop: connected, expiring soon, expired, needs reconnecting, restricted or disconnected, and how many upcoming posts a broken account is blocking.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: Shows the shop's current Xyla settings for one setting group, with the ids change_settings needs and how each field works. Call it without tool to list the setting groups. Read a group before changing it.

tools.name: change_settings
tools.description: Changes the shop's Xyla settings in one setting group (or a few related ones) and returns each value before and after plus an undo id. Every change in a call applies, or none does. Read the group with get_settings first, and confirm the change with the merchant before calling this. Changes affect po

tools.name: undo_change
tools.description: Puts back the settings a change set replaced, using the undo id from change_settings or change_history. The whole set is undone, or nothing is. It is refused when a setting has changed again since, so a newer choice is never overwritten.

tools.name: change_history
tools.description: Lists recent changes to the shop's Xyla settings, newest first: what changed, before and after, who made it (the merchant, Xyla or the assistant), and the undo id to pass to undo_change.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Makes a one-use link that connects a social account to this Xyla shop, or reconnects a broken one. Give the merchant the link to open in their browser; it works once and expires in 10 minutes, and asks for the store's email. To reconnect an account from connection_status, pass its social_media_accou

tools.name: approve_posts
tools.description: Approves posts in this Xyla shop that are waiting for approval, by their IDs from pending_approvals. Each approved post takes the next free slot in the schedule; nothing publishes straight away. Posts in the shop's first batch cannot be approved one by one: use approve_first_batch for those.

tools.name: reject_post
tools.description: Rejects one post in this Xyla shop that is waiting for approval, by its ID from pending_approvals. The post is cancelled and will not be published.

tools.name: approve_first_batch
tools.description: Approves this Xyla shop's first batch of posts as a whole. When the shop can publish, this also turns autopilot on in include mode (the posts already made are scheduled and nothing is deleted), and releases posts held for review into the schedule. Posts go out at their scheduled times, not straight

tools.name: request_post_fix
tools.description: Starts a fix for one post's image or video in this Xyla shop. Xyla first checks the media for a problem on its side, which makes the fix free; otherwise the fix costs credits. Nothing is changed or charged yet. Then call post_fix_status with the audit_id to learn the cost, tell the merchant, and cal

tools.name: post_fix_status
tools.description: Reports where a post fix from request_post_fix stands in this Xyla shop: still being checked, free (Xyla found a problem on its side), or how many credits it costs. After confirm_post_fix, reports whether the fix is running, done or failed.

tools.name: confirm_post_fix
tools.description: Runs a post fix that request_post_fix started in this Xyla shop, with the change the merchant asked for. Call post_fix_status first and tell the merchant whether it is free or what it costs; a fix that is not free uses the shop's credits. The new image or video replaces the post's media when it is r

tools.name: set_autopilot
tools.description: Turns Xyla autopilot on or off for this shop. tools.name: preview_store
tools.description: Shows what Xyla would post for an online store, with no Xyla account. Give it the store's web address (Shopify or WooCommerce). Xyla reads the store's brand (logo, colours, niche) and makes 3 sample social media posts from the store's own product photos, with captions. Returns a preview token at onc

tools.name: preview_status
tools.description: Checks a store preview started with preview_store: the brand Xyla found and the sample posts finished so far. done is true once the preview is ready or has stopped. While the preview card is showing it updates itself, so only call this when no card is shown, every few seconds.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "change_settings" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Changes the shop's Xyla settings in one setting group (or a few related ones) and returns each value before and after plus an undo id. Every change in a call ap…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: change_settings, connect_account, set_autopilot · Private data: preview_store · Public sink: upcoming_posts, pending_approvals, connect_account, approve_posts, reject_post, approve_first_batch, request_post_fix, post_fix_status, confirm_post_fix, set_autopilot, preview_store.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: change_settings, connect_account, set_autopilot · Private data: preview_store · Public sink: upcoming_posts, pending_approvals, connect_account, approve_posts, reject_post, approve_first_batch, request_post_fix, post_fix_status, confirm_post_fix, set_autopilot, preview_store

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
